title: Validate machine-readable CCP2 evidence results
description:
Scope: the evidence contract in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/ccp-conformance.md and focused result-validation code/tests in the existing /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/tools/ and /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/python/tests/ locations as needed. Define a small machine-readable result schema containing requirement/case IDs, implementation, source revision, corpus digest, command, environment, artifact and pass/fail/not-assessed evidence class. Use independently authored result documents to check the validator. Do not create a generic reporting framework or treat policy tests as integrated/RF/authorization evidence.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse existing result/report helpers where suitable; add only the minimal schema and validation needed for joined CCP2 evidence. This is downstream of independent corpus freezing and upstream of final CI aggregation.
acceptance_criteria: Focused validator tests accept complete correctly classified result records and reject empty results, missing artifacts, unknown cases/classes, duplicate records and mismatched source/corpus revisions. Missing evidence stays not assessed and cannot upgrade a claim. A changed source, vector or affected waveform invalidates the corresponding evidence binding. The format accommodates separate frozen base-corpus and admission-supplement digests without rewriting either oracle.
